decision: Accept one deployment-aligned adaptation package, group12 three folds versus frozen matched zero-shot; do not claim superiority to v81.
scope: No model implementation, GPU, fitting, new candidate score, old holdout labels, or online-score-driven parameter selection in this review.
hypothesis: Remove training support/query group overlap and choose adaptation duration on unseen groups, matching official train/test group separation. This is a hypothesis, not an established cause of v81 performance.

fixed_recipe.relation: GroupId is the string prefix before underscore in PassengerId. Used only for splitting and sampling; never a model feature.
fixed_recipe.input: Same original compact13, missing/category processing, official train-only MitraPreprocessor and frozen v2 checkpoint as v81.
fixed_recipe.development: Same original6954 rows, sorted; exact historical row hash and frozen group assignment verified by diagnose.py.
fixed_recipe.outer: Frozen StratifiedGroupKFold3(shuffle=True,random_state=20261112) from matched Mitra group12 OOF. Do not choose/retry splits.
fixed_recipe.inner: First fold of StratifiedGroupKFold5(shuffle=True,random_state=fit_seed) within current outer training pool. Assert GroupId and knownCabin disjoint. No validation targets enter model fitting/support.
fixed_recipe.preprocessing: Fit only inner training inputs for selection. After selection discard model/optimizer/preprocessor/RNG; reseed and freshly fit preprocessing on full outer training data.
fixed_recipe.episode_rng: numpy.random.default_rng(fit_seed), independently reset at start of selection and fresh full refit.
fixed_recipe.episode_query: perm = rng.permutation(len(current_training_pool)); query=perm[1024:1280]. Never redraw/reorder/stratify the query.
fixed_recipe.episode_support: Filter the entire perm to rows whose GroupId is absent from all query GroupIds; take the first1024. Assert disjoint row IDs and groups. If fewer than1024 remain, fail explicitly; never reduce context or retry query.
fixed_recipe.training: All75,670,026 parameters; persistent AdamW; native10-class CE; baseLR3e-6,weight_decay.3,betas(.9,.999),eps1e-8; exact existing literal warmup; fixed50 updates.
fixed_recipe.selection: Evaluate full-inner-training-context binary logloss at steps0..50, choose strict minimum with earliest exact tie. Clear gradients immediately after every optimizer step and before validation; optimizer moments remain resident.
fixed_recipe.refit: Fresh original checkpoint, reset seed/RNG, full-outertrain preprocessing. Train exactly selected number of group-disjoint episodes; selected0 returns fresh original weights. No retained selection weights or frozen-prefix cache.
fixed_recipe.inference: Original full-support MitraPredictor; query_chunk2318; FP32weights/input, MPSbf16autocast, original exact SDPA/checkpoint backend, allocator cap.65. No hidden truncation.
fixed_recipe.horizon: Max50 fixed; report cap selection, do not autoextend.
fixed_recipe.failure_policy: Stage timeout/resource/sampler errors are incomplete, never partial success or implicit fallback.

evaluation_and_limits.primary: Only the new candidate group12 threefold OOF vs cached matched original Mitra with identical dev IDs/folds. Cached v44 can be contextual reference.
evaluation_and_limits.report: Keep group-only metrics in a distinct table; never insert them into random A/B ranking as directly comparable scores.
evaluation_and_limits.not_v81_comparison: Original v81 score is random-fold. To claim superiority over v81 or isolate sampling benefit, an additional old-v81 run on identical group folds is necessary. Current scope deliberately does not expand to six fits.
evaluation_and_limits.not_one_factor: Both episode sampling and inner selection split change as one fixed deployment-aligned package. Any gain belongs to the package, not uniquely to one mechanism.
evaluation_and_limits.not_independent: Group12 and same6954 labels have already been used. This is adaptive repeated-development validation, not a fresh holdout.
evaluation_and_limits.no_automatic_eligibility: This design creates neither new A/S eligibility nor upload authorization; root applies current explicit user authorization separately.

counterevidence_and_sampling_bias: Existing zero-shot GroupCV accuracy is slightly higher than random CV; there is no evidence that current CV performance is primarily inflated by same-group support. Do not call ordinary training-only peer labels leakage.
Mitra receives no explicit GroupId, so it is uncertain how much same-group similarity influences inference; removing overlap need not improve accuracy.

Query rows remain uniform and their positions exactly match the old sampler conditional on the same ordered training pool/permutation. New inner membership/order differs, so entire fits do not share identical old-v81 query rows.

Large groups are more likely to be touched by the row-uniform query draw and therefore excluded from support. The resulting support group-size distribution changes intentionally; do not claim uniform-group sampling or exact equality to the official split-generating process.
The mechanism addresses unseen-group support, but does not remove episode1024 vs full-context training/inference size shift or all other synthetic-pretraining/domain differences.
GroupId suffices for knownCabin separation in the actual roster: no observed full Cabin spans groups. Missing cabins must not be merged into one group. Do not expand to surname-connected components.
Previous weak/negative adaptation experiments lower the prior expectation of reliable gains; one controlled test is justified, not guaranteed useful or grounds for repeated sampler/LR search.

cost.expected_new_three_fold_hours: approximately2.6, same tensor shapes and similar selection/full-refit work; actual selected steps and runtime can vary
cost.extra_matched_old_v81_if_later_required: approximately another2.6h; not currently authorized as part of this experiment
cost.resource_basis: Training1024/256 and fullcontext validation shapes unchanged or differ by one row; preserve established memory cap/backend. No new GPU probe executed in review.

independent_battle.conclusion: Conditional agreement for one fixed package vs zero-shot, with matched-v81 and adaptive-validation limitations explicit. No relation/parameter/seed expansion.
